title: Shattered Carousel Escape
description: A woman in a red velvet dress and black heels stands on broken stone stairs, one hand pressed against a massive shattered mirror or glass pane. Through the jagged glass fragments, a glowing carousel with horses is visible under a dramatic twilight sky. Scattered debris including a wax seal, papers, a white glove, and a picture frame litter the steps.
